title: Keycaps drawn from kbd
blurb: A shortcut list and a keyboard made of <kbd> elements. The canvas draws each one as a keycap that goes down while the real key is held, or while a finger is on it. A press sends a ring of light across the other keys.
question: Can each <kbd> in a document be drawn as its own moving keycap, driven by the real keyboard and by touch, while the list around it stays one drawn element?
result: Yes. A <kbd drawable> inside a drawn element is left out of the parent's picture, draws on its own and keeps its own hit region.
